text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup is here! The final
chapter of
our classic year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dirt G1 races around this period are
all
mixed-year races between classic and
senior year
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Yeah, the showdown is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them, the Champions Cup is one
of the
rare G1 dirt races held in central.
It attracts
top-class runners like Hokko
Tarumae and
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about it, we've been through a
lot since
I made my debut. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The eight mansions chart we've drawn is
huge, full
of surprising twists and turns.
But we've come this
far together...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And we did it while determined to bring
smiles to
everyone with feng shui,
whether they were
chasing their dreams
or fighting their demons!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Although, I guess getting carried away
before
summer set me behind schedule a
bit...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If only I had spent more time training,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are some things you'll never
notice unless
you try them, even if it
means taking a little
detour.
choice_data_list: That's all part of learning, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So it wouldn't be right to call them
mistakes.
Because learning that you're
going in the wrong
direction is how you
find the right one.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're right. ☆ It's just as you say,
Trainer!
Don't look away, and don't look
back! Keep your
eyes fixed straight
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! It's time for our showdown with
Tarumae
and Acute!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae! Acute! Let's do our best today!
I still
can't match up to you in
experience...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I have feng shui on my side!
Rickey! ☆
Lucky! ☆ Super turnaround!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I'll be proving you wrong. I've
done
nothing but put my heart and soul
into my
running, all for my beloved
Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not going to lose to you, Rickey,
after all
the detours you've taken. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching you. I want to find out if
you're
good enough to make it in your
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Come now, you two, let's all get along!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you start fighting, I'll have to defuse
the
situation by beating you both.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, but that's not going to happen!
I won't
give up that easily!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Man, even with the stakes so high, they
look like
they're right at home. They're
not nervous at all.
Still...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My luck is on the rise! After all the work
I've done
to make sure everything's in
order, all that's left is
to go with the
flow!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! Onward, with the Azure
Dragon at my
side! I'll show these two
the power of feng shui!
